error_text: [NUM_COLUMNS_MISMATCH] UNION can only be performed on inputs with the same number of columns, but the first input has 32 columns and the second input has 35 columns. SQLSTATE: 42826
documented_root_cause: schema_commons.py contained pipl_transfer_* columns not present in the current_consent_state Delta version — unionByName() failed without allowMissingColumns=True
documented_fix: Updated both unionByName() calls with allowMissingColumns=True

error_text: Exception: Could not write to destination as dataframe having zero records
documented_root_cause: Upstream feed to ePrint.dbo.PrinterSecureInfo had stopped producing data for 7 days; job logic processes data 2 days older than run date
documented_fix: Upstream team resolved the feed; no code change needed on this side

error_text: [FIELD_NOT_FOUND] No such struct field `idpId` in `country`, `createdAt`, `email`, `eventTrigger`, `familyName`, `givenName`, `idpType`, `locale`, `messageAttributes`, `updatedAt`, `version`. SQLSTATE: 42704 and Exception: No new psoobe stream data is available for processing
documented_root_cause: dbutils.notebook.run blue/green notebook path branching for the EOS API job resolved incorrectly, causing NotebookExecutionException
documented_fix: Replaced dbutils.notebook.run with a direct WorkspaceClient.jobs.run_now(job_id=...) call targeting the EOS job by stable job_id instead of dynamic notebook paths
note: Two split signals in one paste — FIELD_NOT_FOUND and 'no new data' — must be treated as related (checkpoint-stall pattern), not two independent incidents.

documented_root_cause: Upstream schema changed on 20th April — columns removed, renamed, and data types changed in the source Parquet files
documented_fix: Upstream team (Ken Mazur) re-processed and re-uploaded corrected-schema files
backfill_window: 2026-04-20 to latest at time of fix

documented_root_cause: Job used path-based access to a table now requiring Unity Catalog managed table write flow
documented_fix: Implemented code changes to support Unity Catalog managed table write flow for hpone_devices

error_text: Cluster '0817-121124-jrabw8wi' was terminated. Reason: SPARK_ERROR (SERVICE_FAULT). SparkInternalError: Spark error: Driver down cause: driver state change.
documented_root_cause: Databricks infrastructure fault adding workers to the compute cluster — not a code issue
documented_fix: None required on the job's code side; retriggered

documented_root_cause: Large number of small files in team_onecloud_prod.cdm_base.stg_simple_ui_v2_software causing shuffle/read performance issues; also a DBR version regression (16.4 rollback fixed it once)
documented_fix: Rolled back DBR version to 16.4; separately flagged for OPTIMIZE on the source table
note: Real example where 'transient' classification was only PARTIALLY correct — recurred across multiple runs, suggesting a real underlying capacity/config issue, not a one-off blip. Good test case for the recurring-failure check in classify.py.

documented_root_cause: Advertising_New_Common_Purpose_ID present in notebook's default job parameters but missing from prod.yml config
documented_fix: Added the missing key to prod.yml with the correct value
